name: Houston Wire & Cable
old_description: Houston Wire & Cable is a manufacturer of electrical wire and cable. Product range includes power cables, communication cables and custom cable assemblies for energy, industrial and commercial applications.
about:
Houston Wire & Cable operates from Houston, Texas, where it was founded in 1906. The company has grown to employ over 1,000 people and maintains UL Listed certification for its product lines.

The company manufactures electrical wire and cable, including power cables, communication cables, and custom cable assemblies. Its product portfolio encompasses electrical wire, cables, power cords, and cable assemblies designed for a range of voltage and environmental requirements. Production capabilities include custom cable assembly services tailored to specific application needs.

Houston Wire & Cable serves the energy, industrial, and commercial sectors. In the energy market, its cables support power generation and distribution infrastructure. Industrial customers rely on the company's wire and cable for machinery, automation, and control systems. Commercial applications include building wiring, communications infrastructure, and specialty installations.

The company's UL Listed certification underscores its commitment to meeting recognized safety standards across its product lines.
